name: Doorway Chest Stretch

instructions.description: Stand sideways next to the doorway and place one forearm against the door frame, with your elbow slightly below shoulder height and bent at approximately 90°.
Step forward slowly with the foot closest to the doorway until you feel a gentle stretch across your chest and the front of your shoulder.
Keep your torso upright, shoulders relaxed, and hips facing forward. Breathe slowly and comfortably while holding the stretch.
Step back to release the stretch, lower your arm, and repeat on the other side.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.

variations.variationDescription: Doorway Chest Stretch — Supported Mobility Version: Add stable support or cushions to reduce balance or floor-access demands.

commentsNotes: Use a gentle stretch and avoid forcing the shoulder.
Keep your shoulder relaxed and away from your ear.
Maintain an upright posture without arching your lower back.
Adjust your step and arm position to control the intensity of the stretch.
